extraction_evidence: scripts/package-windows-studio.py constructs an explicit file allowlist and verifies every archived byte against the current EXE, generated legal tree, Studio license, LICENSE-NOTICE and portable README. scripts/check-native-release-artifacts.py repeats that verification on the final ZIP, safely extracts it, and checks the complete native inventory. The EXE must exactly match the original build; no installer bundle-type mutation is permitted. Local fixture tests exercise malformed archives, altered bytes, unexpected files, and runtime imports. Actual build hashes and full payload evidence are emitted per CI run; this packaging review does not certify native GUI behavior.
bootstrapper_and_system_runtime_review: The ZIP contains two first-party EXEs (Studio and the matching CLI) and legal/readme files, with no installer, bootstrapper, bundled DLL, or WebView2 browser runtime. Tauri build.windows.staticVCRuntime is explicitly true (Tauri configuration reference); pinned webview2-com-sys 0.39.1 uses WebView2LoaderStatic for the MSVC target (src/lib.rs). The PE import and delay-import tables are checked against Windows OS DLL names; unexpected runtime DLL imports fail. Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen Runtime remains a host prerequisite, documented in the shipped README. It is included in Windows 11 and installed on most Windows 10 devices. Native launch must be tested separately.

bundled_cli_contract.identity: bin/manifest.json records canonical workspace version, platform RID, exact CLI SHA256 and source commit. Final extracted package verification compares the staged manifest and original first-party bytes, checks the separate CLI MIT license, and executes only the verified CLI --version with a 15-second timeout.
bundled_cli_contract.license: bin/LICENSE-CLI.txt plus the complete shared legal aggregate
bundled_cli_contract.scope: The Devcel CLI only; no AI harness, shell wrapper, PATH lookup or arbitrary executable is bundled. Actual artifact identities are emitted by each build; historical extraction evidence below is retained as historical evidence.
